How confidence is setIt follows the kind of evidence, not judgement.
  • The customer's own statement (high confidence at most): The organisation says so itself: its press release, website, annual report or a named executive on the record.
  • Regulatory or securities filing (high confidence at most): A filing by the customer or the vendor names the relationship.
  • Independent press (high confidence at most): Editorially independent reporting describes the deployment.
  • Joint announcement (medium confidence at most): A press release issued with the vendor, usually with a quote from the customer.
  • Vendor case study (medium confidence at most): The vendor's published customer story naming the organisation.
  • Vendor mention only (low confidence at most): A logo, a customer list or a passing mention by the vendor, with nothing from the customer.
  • An organisation that also holds a stake in the vendor is labelled “Investor and customer” and is never rated above medium.
  • A partnership is listed as a partner, not a customer.

Security incidentsAccording to ManageEngine's PAM360 release notes, builds released between April and July 2026 fixed seven numbered vulnerabilities in the product: SQL injection flaws (CVE-2026-5785, CVE-2026-11840, CVE-2026-14828), an authentication bypass (CVE-2026-12263), remote code execution flaws (CVE-2026-6213 in a third-party package and CVE-2026-18199) and a path traversal in a third-party library (CVE-2026-8326). Questions to ask the vendor (6)

  1. What was Zoho Corporation's audited revenue and profit in its last financial year, and what share came from ManageEngine?
    Revenue shows the scale behind the product.
  2. Has Zoho Corporation or ManageEngine reduced its workforce in the last 24 months?
    Workforce reductions bear on support quality.
  3. Has Zoho Corporation or ManageEngine been subject to any regulatory investigation, order or penalty in the last five years?
    Regulatory action against a privileged-access vendor bears on a bank's own supervisory standing.
  4. Is Zoho Corporation or ManageEngine party to any pending or recently resolved material litigation?
    Material litigation can affect the vendor.
  5. Has ManageEngine lost any notable PAM360 customer in the last 24 months, and why?
    Customer departures can signal product or service problems.
  6. What changes have there been in Zoho Corporation's and ManageEngine's leadership in the last 24 months?
    Leadership changes at a founder-led private company affect direction.

  2. 2026-06-09 · vulnerability disclosure ManageEngine (Zoho Corporation)
    PAM360 build 8551 fixes an authentication bypass and a SQL injection flaw

    According to ManageEngine's PAM360 release notes, build 8551 of 2026-06-09 fixed CVE-2026-12263, an authentication bypass, and CVE-2026-11840, a SQL injection flaw. Earlier 2026 builds fixed CVE-2026-5785 (SQL injection, 2 April), CVE-2026-6213 (remote code execution in a third-party package, 7 April) and CVE-2026-8326 (path traversal in a third-party library, 22 May).
